study.title: Long read genome assemblers struggle with small plasmids

scope.short_reads: reference-construction provenance only; never assembly inputs in this track
scope.pilot_reason: same-isolate deposited reference with two small native plasmids and two larger controls; selection is proposed, not executable

historical_reproduction.note: Do not claim exact historical reproduction with regenerated subsets or modern versions. Paper Flye-meta setting is historical context only; it does not admit a metagenomic dataset/benchmark arm.

paper_recovery.quantity: sum of PAF alignment-block lengths, with per-draft-contig filtering/fallback in the pinned R code; no union/deduplication
paper_recovery.chromosome_incorporation: historical code classifies draft contigs longer than 1,000,000 bp as chromosome
paper_recovery.duplication: paper records multiple draft contigs recovering the same reference plasmid
paper_recovery.caveat: Published Miniasm/Minipolish snippet and mapping command orientation require audit before literal replay.

benchmark_contiguity.quantity: longest single alignment against tripled reference / native reference length; uncapped

reference_provenance.construction: Paper reports Trycycler consensus from replicate drafts followed by long-read and short-read polishing; short-read/hybrid methods are provenance, not test arms
reference_provenance.independence: References partly derive from tested assembler families; circularity/CheckM and unused-read checks do not establish fully independent truth
reference_provenance.table_discrepancies: Pinned supplementary-data-2 has all33 plasmids and matches deposited lengths; article Table1 differs for ATCC25922, ATCC25923 and2022QW-00133. Never silently use Table1 as inventory.
reference_provenance.ng_annotation_conflict: CP119139.1/CP119141.1 are4,207/4,153bp records labelled chromosome; CP119140.1/CP119142.1 are~2.17Mb records labelled plasmid in ENA and NCBI. Proposed biological roles inferred from paper sizes require explicit resolution before admission.

data_usage.article: Creative Commons Attribution, per PMC copyright statement
data_usage.note: No dataset-specific CC or public-domain licence is asserted for deposited reads/reference or supporting repository code.

source_receipts.query_note: ENA filereport read_run for the three stated BioProjects, filtered by the fourteen exact paper isolate aliases. Shared surveillance projects contain many unrelated records and are not panels.
